Self-healing cybersecurity for remote workforces: See and secure all your devices, apps, and data — even off the corporate network

Absolute is factory-embedded in the firmware of over 500 million devices, allowing it to persist through removal, reimaging, and even hard drive swaps.

Chances are, your organization is suddenly grappling with every employee working from home. And your IT and security teams are tasked with ensuring secure, uninterrupted access to corporate networks.

You may not realize that your devices already contain a powerful tool for ensuring that endpoint security and management tasks can continue unabated. All you have to do is activate it.

Absolute is the only endpoint security solution factory-embedded in firmware of every major device manufacturer, including Dell, Lenovo, and HP.

Not only does this provide an unprecedented ability to manage devices at scale, and extend your security beyond the corporate network — it makes Absolute self-healing and persistent through virtually any attempt to remove it.

Successfully managing remote workforces with Absolute:
- Configure, query, and remediate devices at scale without the need for physical access
- Locate lost or stolen devices and prevent access by unauthorized users
- Get real-time alerts when devices present vulnerabilities
- Pinpoint where sensitive data resides and remotely remove it from compromised endpoints
- Automatically repair and reinstall mission-critical applications if misconfigured, corrupted or removed
- Maintain a persistent VPN connection
